summary: Markdown and JSON handlers define safe parse/create/recovery boundaries and exact malformed-input symptoms.
CSV import/export is lossy for whitespace and maps CSV to text columns/row cells; opened CSV edits are memory-only.
Formula grammar, function set, type errors, id-based references, and write-through computed cells are source-confirmed.
Remaining simple renderer value formats are confirmed for text, number, checkbox, URL, and email.
AI agents should patch by stable IDs, preserve arrays/unknown optional fields, and treat multi-sort and columnOrder as conservative unresolved areas unless runtime evidence is added.
